name: AI-Scientist
notes: No test suite and no CI in the repo (REPOS.json tests: none; no tests/, no .github/), so test_cmd is the v3 smoke check. Python 3.11.17 (uv-managed; aider-chat needs <3.13). No pyproject/setup.py, so nothing is installed editable: setup installs requirements.txt (--exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z; resolved aider-chat 0.86.2, openai 2.20.0, anthropic 1.13.0, litellm 1.81.10, google-generativeai 0.8.6, torch 2.14.1, numpy 1.26.4) and the code is imported from the working copy via cwd + PYTHONPATH=. (no reinstall step needed). The smoke command counts 10 checks and prints a pytest-style 'N passed in Xs' (or 'M failed, N passed in Xs', exit 1) line that parse_counts reads: (1-4) compileall of ai_scientist/, launch_scientist.py, experimental/ and review_iclr_bench/; (5-10) importlib.import_module of ai_scientist.llm (all direct OpenAI/Anthropic call sites + create_client), ai_scientist.generate_ideas, ai_scientist.perform_experiments, ai_scientist.perform_review, ai_scientist.perform_writeup, and launch_scientist (aider Model() sites; imports torch, aider, openai and every ai_scientist module). It does not construct clients or call any LLM (create_client is never invoked), so it needs no keys; dummy OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/DEEPSEEK/OPENROUTER/GEMINI keys are set only to neutralise import-time side effects, LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True stops LiteLLM fetching its price map, WANDB/HF are forced offline. HOME, TMPDIR and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX are sandboxed into $ENV so the working copy stays clean (git status empty after a run). Templates (torch experiment code, no LLM calls) and notebooks are not checked. Baseline taken in base/AI-Scientist with RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset and outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed; curl to api.openai.com confirmed blocked): two runs, identical 10 passed (12.07s cold / 5.20s warm in-script; 12.6s / 5.8s wall). Negative control: replacing 'import openai' in a scratch copy of ai_scientist/llm.py gave '5 failed, 5 passed', exit 1. Expected noise: a FutureWarning from google.generativeai (deprecated) on import of ai_scientist.llm. test_kind is left as 'unit' because the smoke command produces pass/fail counts like a test run, but it is an import/compile smoke check, not unit tests.
